cohort: 220 antenatal women between 22 and 28 weeks of gestation.
finding: Elevated maternal mid-pregnancy CRP levels were significantly associated with preterm delivery and improved APGAR scores at 1 and 5 minutes, while lower CRP levels were associated with a higher incidence of PPROM.
mod_finding: No significant association was found between CRP levels and mode of delivery.
gest_age: 22 to 28 weeks of gestation at enrollment
